paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: Comparison between PyramidInfer and full cache baseline with different batch sizes on the LLaMA 2-7B model with input length of 512+256.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between batch size and throughput (tokens per second) for two different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Batch Size" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 60, with tick labels at intervals of 20 units. The y-axis is labeled "Throughput (tokens/s)" and also uses a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 2500, with tick labels every 500 units. The plot features two lines. The first line is pink with circular markers and a solid style, representing "PyramidInfer." It starts at approximately (0, 0) and increases steadily, reaching around (62, 2600). The second line is teal with circular markers and a solid style, representing "Full Cache." It begins at roughly (0, 0) as well, rises to approximately (30, 1250), and then shows a slight decline to around (62, 950). A legend is placed at the left top center of the plot describing the line pattern with the corresponding method.
